def clean_text(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    text = text.strip()
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[^\x00-\x7F\w\s\.\,\!\?\;\:\'\"\-\(\)\[\]\{\}]", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text

def extract_basic_features(texts):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=range(len(texts)))
    features["char_count"] = [len(t) for t in texts]
    features["word_count"] = [len(t.split()) for t in texts]
    features["avg_word_length"] = features["char_count"] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["sentence_count"] = [len(re.split(r"[.!?]+", t)) - 1 for t in texts]
    features["avg_sentence_length"] = features["word_count"] / (
        features["sentence_count"] + 1
    )
    for punct in [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", '"', "'", "-", "...", "--"]:
        features[f"punct_{punct}"] = [t.count(punct) for t in texts]
    features["punct_ratio"] = features[
        [f"punct_{p}" for p in [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", '"', "'", "-"]]
    ].sum(axis=1) / (features["char_count"] + 1)
    features["capital_ratio"] = [
        sum(1 for c in t if c.isupper()) / (len(t) + 1) for t in texts
    ]
    features["all_caps_words"] = [len(re.findall(r"\b[A-Z]{2,}\b", t)) for t in texts]
    features["quote_count"] = [t.count('"') + t.count('"') for t in texts]
    features["paren_count"] = [
        t.count("(") + t.count(")") + t.count("[") + t.count("]") for t in texts
    ]
    features["exclamation_ratio"] = features["punct_!"] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["question_ratio"] = features["punct_?"] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    sentences = [re.split(r"[.!?]+", t) for t in texts]
    features["starts_with_and"] = [
        sum(1 for s in sent_list if s.strip().lower().startswith("and"))
        for sent_list in sentences
    ]
    features["starts_with_but"] = [
        sum(1 for s in sent_list if s.strip().lower().startswith("but"))
        for sent_list in sentences
    ]
    features["starts_with_the"] = [
        sum(1 for s in sent_list if s.strip().lower().startswith("the"))
        for sent_list in sentences
    ]
    return features

def extract_readability_features(texts):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=range(len(texts)))

    def count_syllables(word):
        word = word.lower()
        vowels = "aeiouy"
        count = 0
        prev_vowel = False
        for char in word:
            if char in vowels:
                if not prev_vowel:
                    count += 1
                prev_vowel = True
            else:
                prev_vowel = False
        if count == 0:
            count = 1
        return count

    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        words = re.findall(r"\b\w+\b", text)
        if len(words) == 0:
            features.loc[i, "syllable_count"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "flesch_reading_ease"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "avg_syllables_per_word"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "long_word_ratio"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "very_long_word_ratio"] = 0
            continue
        syllables = sum(count_syllables(w) for w in words)
        sentences = max(len(re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)) - 1, 1)
        features.loc[i, "syllable_count"] = syllables
        features.loc[i, "avg_syllables_per_word"] = syllables / len(words)
        features.loc[i, "long_word_ratio"] = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 8) / len(
            words
        )
        features.loc[i, "very_long_word_ratio"] = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 12
        ) / len(words)
        if sentences > 0 and len(words) > 0:
            fre = (
                206.835
                - 1.015 * (len(words) / sentences)
                - 84.6 * (syllables / len(words))
            )
            features.loc[i, "flesch_reading_ease"] = max(0, min(100, fre))
        else:
            features.loc[i, "flesch_reading_ease"] = 0
    return features

def extract_tfidf_features(texts, fit=False, vectorizer=None):
    if fit:
        vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char",
            ngram_range=(2, 5),
            max_features=5000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
        )
        tfidf_matrix = vectorizer.fit_transform(texts)
        return tfidf_matrix, vectorizer
    else:
        tfidf_matrix = vectorizer.transform(texts)
        return tfidf_matrix, None

def extract_all_features(texts, fit_tfidf=False, tfidf_vectorizer=None):

    print("Extracting basic features...")
    basic_feats = extract_basic_features(texts)
    features_list.append(basic_feats)
    print("Extracting lexical features...")
    lexical_feats = extract_lexical_features(texts)
    features_list.append(lexical_feats)
    print("Extracting readability features...")
    readability_feats = extract_readability_features(texts)
    features_list.append(readability_feats)
    print("Extracting author-specific features...")
    author_feats = extract_author_specific_features(texts)
    features_list.append(author_feats)
    print("Extracting function word features...")
    func_word_feats = extract_function_word_features(texts)
    features_list.append(func_word_feats)
    print("Extracting TF-IDF features...")
    if fit_tfidf:
        tfidf_matrix, tfidf_vectorizer = extract_tfidf_features(texts, fit=True)
        tfidf_feats = pd.DataFrame(
            tfidf_matrix.toarray(),
            columns=[f"tfidf_{i}" for i in range(tfidf_matrix.shape[1])],
        )
        features_list.append(tfidf_feats)
        tfidf_vectorizer_out = tfidf_vectorizer
    else:
        tfidf_matrix, _ = extract_tfidf_features(
            texts, fit=False, vectorizer=tfidf_vectorizer
        )
        tfidf_feats = pd.DataFrame(
            tfidf_matrix.toarray(),
            columns=[f"tfidf_{i}" for i in range(tfidf_matrix.shape[1])],
        )
        features_list.append(tfidf_feats)
        tfidf_vectorizer_out = None
    all_features = pd.concat(features_list, axis=1)
    all_features = all_features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    all_features = all_features.fillna(0)
    return all_features, tfidf_vectorizer_out

NUM_CLASSES = 3

LABEL_SMOOTHING = 0.1


class AuthorshipFusionModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, feature_dim, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, dropout_rate=DROPOUT_RATE):
        super().__init__()
        self.transformer = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            TRANSFORMER_MODEL,
            num_labels=num_classes,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        self.feature_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(feature_dim, 512),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
        )
        self.fusion = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.transformer.config.hidden_size + 64, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(128, num_classes),
        )
        for module in self.feature_branch:
            if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.kaiming_normal_(
                    module.weight, mode="fan_in", nonlinearity="relu"
                )
                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
        for module in self.fusion:
            if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.xavier_normal_(module.weight)
                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, features):
        outputs = self.transformer.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        cls_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        transformer_logits = self.transformer.classifier(cls_hidden)

        cls_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        transformer_logits = self.transformer.classifier(cls_hidden)
        feature_embed = self.feature_branch(features)
        combined = torch.cat([cls_hidden, feature_embed], dim=1)
        logits = self.fusion(combined)
        logits = logits + 0.3 * transformer_logits
        return logits


class LabelSmoothCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=LABEL_SMOOTHING):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = torch.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (NUM_CLASSES - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        loss = torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))
        return loss

class AuthorshipDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, features, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.features = (
            torch.FloatTensor(features.values)
            if hasattr(features, "values")
            else torch.FloatTensor(features)
        )
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.encodings = []
        for text in texts:
            encoding = self.tokenizer(
                text,
                truncation=True,
                padding=False,
                max_length=self.max_length,
                return_tensors=None,
            )
            self.encodings.append(
                {
                    "input_ids": encoding["input_ids"],
                    "attention_mask": encoding["attention_mask"],
                }
            )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(
                self.encodings[idx]["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                self.encodings[idx]["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
            "features": self.features[idx],
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


def collate_fn(batch):
    input_ids = [item["input_ids"] for item in batch]
    attention_mask = [item["attention_mask"] for item in batch]
    features = torch.stack([item["features"] for item in batch])
    input_ids = torch.nn.utils.rnn.pad_sequence(
        input_ids, batch_first=True, padding_value=0
    )
    attention_mask = torch.nn.utils.rnn.pad_sequence(
        attention_mask, batch_first=True, padding_value=0
    )
    result = {
        "input_ids": input_ids,
        "attention_mask": attention_mask,
        "features": features,
    }
    if "labels" in batch[0]:
        result["labels"] = torch.stack([item["labels"] for item in batch])
    return result


train_dataset = AuthorshipDataset(
    texts=train_data["text"].tolist(),
    features=train_features,
    labels=train_labels,
    tokenizer=tokenizer,
    max_length=512,
)
val_dataset = AuthorshipDataset(
    texts=val_data["text"].tolist(),
    features=val_features,
    labels=val_labels,
    tokenizer=tokenizer,
    max_length=512,
)
test_dataset = AuthorshipDataset(
    texts=test_data["text"].tolist(),
    features=test_features,
    labels=None,
    tokenizer=tokenizer,
    max_length=512,
)

BATCH_SIZE = 16
ACCUMULATION_STEPS = 2
train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    shuffle=True,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
    collate_fn=collate_fn,
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
    collate_fn=collate_fn,
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
    collate_fn=collate_fn,
)

# ============================================================
# 8. TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
NUM_EPOCHS = 30
EARLY_STOPPING_PATIENCE = 5
MAX_GRAD_NORM = 1.0
WARMUP_STEPS = 100
TOTAL_STEPS = (len(train_data) // (BATCH_SIZE * ACCUMULATION_STEPS)) * NUM_EPOCHS


def get_warmup_scheduler(optimizer, warmup_steps, total_steps):
    def lr_lambda(current_step):
        if current_step < warmup_steps:
            return float(current_step) / float(max(1, warmup_steps))
        return max(
            0.0,
            float(total_steps - current_step)
            / float(max(1, total_steps - warmup_steps)),
        )

    return torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(optimizer, lr_lambda)


scheduler = get_warmup_scheduler(optimizer, WARMUP_STEPS, TOTAL_STEPS)

print("\nStarting training...")
best_val_loss = float("inf")
best_model_state = None
patience_counter = 0
global_step = 0

for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0.0
    train_batches = 0
    for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(train_loader):
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        features = batch["features"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=device.type == "cuda"):
            logits = model(
                input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, features=features
            )
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)
            loss = loss / ACCUMULATION_STEPS
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        if (batch_idx + 1) % ACCUMULATION_STEPS == 0:
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), MAX_GRAD_NORM)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            scheduler.step()
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            global_step += 1
        train_loss += loss.item() * ACCUMULATION_STEPS
        train_batches += 1
    avg_train_loss = train_loss / train_batches

    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0.0
    val_batches = 0
    all_val_preds = []
    all_val_labels = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            features = batch["features"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
            with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=device.type == "cuda"):
                logits = model(
                    input_ids=input_ids,
                    attention_mask=attention_mask,
                    features=features,
                )
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
            val_loss += loss.item()
            val_batches += 1
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
            all_val_preds.append(probs)
            all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
    avg_val_loss = val_loss / val_batches
    all_val_preds = np.concatenate(all_val_preds, axis=0)
    all_val_labels = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)
    eps = 1e-15
    all_val_preds_clamped = np.clip(all_val_preds, eps, 1 - eps)
    all_val_preds_clamped = all_val_preds_clamped / all_val_preds_clamped.sum(
        axis=1, keepdims=True
    )
    val_log_loss = log_loss(all_val_labels, all_val_preds_clamped)
    current_lr = (
        scheduler.get_last_lr()[0] if scheduler else optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]
    )
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{NUM_EPOCHS} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {avg_val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_log_loss:.4f} | LR: {current_lr:.2e}"
    )
    if avg_val_loss < best_val_loss:
        best_val_loss = avg_val_loss
        best_val_log_loss = val_log_loss
        best_model_state = {
            "model_state_dict": model.state_dict(),
            "optimizer_state_dict": optimizer.state_dict(),
            "epoch": epoch,
            "val_log_loss": val_log_loss,
        }
        torch.save(best_model_state, "./working/best_model.pt")
        patience_counter = 0
        print(f"  → New best model saved! Val LogLoss: {val_log_loss:.4f}")
    else:
        patience_counter += 1
        if patience_counter >= EARLY_STOPPING_PATIENCE:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered after {epoch+1} epochs")
            break

print("\nTraining complete!")

# ============================================================
# 9. LOAD BEST MODEL AND EVALUATE
# ============================================================
print("Loading best model for evaluation...")
checkpoint = torch.load("./working/best_model.pt")
model.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model_state_dict"])
model.eval()

all_val_preds = []
all_val_labels_ = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in val_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        features = batch["features"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=device.type == "cuda"):
            logits = model(
                input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, features=features
            )
        probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        all_val_preds.append(probs)
        all_val_labels_.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
all_val_preds = np.concatenate(all_val_preds, axis=0)
all_val_labels_ = np.concatenate(all_val_labels_, axis=0)
eps = 1e-15
all_val_preds_final = np.clip(all_val_preds, eps, 1 - eps)
all_val_preds_final = all_val_preds_final / all_val_preds_final.sum(
    axis=1, keepdims=True
)
final_val_score = log_loss(all_val_labels_, all_val_preds_final)
print(f"Final Validation Score: {final_val_score}")

# ============================================================
# 10. TEST INFERENCE AND SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
print("Running test inference...")
all_test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        features = batch["features"].to(device)
        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=device.type == "cuda"):
            logits = model(
                input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, features=features
            )
        probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        all_test_preds.append(probs)
all_test_preds = np.concatenate(all_test_preds, axis=0)
all_test_preds_final = np.clip(all_test_preds, eps, 1 - eps)
all_test_preds_final = all_test_preds_final / all_test_preds_final.sum(
    axis=1, keepdims=True
)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_data["id"].values,
        "EAP": all_test_preds_final[:, 0],
        "HPL": all_test_preds_final[:, 1],
        "MWS": all_test_preds_final[:, 2],
    }
)
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")

gc.collect()
torch.cuda.empty_cache()

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

class SpookyAuthorFeatures(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    def __init__(self):

    def _extract_single_text(self, text):
        features = {}
        words = text.split()
        num_words = len(words)
        chars = len(text)

        features["num_words"] = num_words
        features["num_chars"] = chars
        features["avg_word_len"] = chars / max(num_words, 1)
        features["chars_per_word"] = (
            np.mean([len(w) for w in words if w.isalpha()]) if words else 0
        )

        features["num_periods"] = text.count(".")
        features["num_commas"] = text.count(",")
        features["num_semicolons"] = text.count(";")
        features["num_colons"] = text.count(":")
        features["num_exclamations"] = text.count("!")
        features["num_questions"] = text.count("?")
        features["num_quotes"] = text.count('"') + text.count("'")
        features["num_dashes"] = text.count("-") + text.count("—")
        features["num_ellipsis"] = text.count("...")
        features["num_parens"] = text.count("(") + text.count(")")

        features["punct_per_word"] = (
            features["num_periods"]
            + features["num_commas"]
            + features["num_semicolons"]
            + features["num_exclamations"]
            + features["num_questions"]
        ) / max(num_words, 1)

        features["num_capitals"] = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper())
        features["capital_ratio"] = features["num_capitals"] / max(chars, 1)

        cap_words = [w for w in words if w and w[0].isupper()]
        features["num_capitalized_words"] = len(cap_words)
        features["capital_words_ratio"] = len(cap_words) / max(num_words, 1)

        unique_words = set(w.lower() for w in words if w.isalpha())
        features["unique_word_ratio"] = len(unique_words) / max(num_words, 1)

        words_lower = [w.lower().strip(".,!?;:\"'()[]{}") for w in words]
        word_counts = Counter(words_lower)

        for fw in self.function_words:
            features[f"fw_{fw}"] = word_counts.get(fw, 0) / max(num_words, 1)

        features["archaic_word_count"] = sum(
            1 for w in words_lower if w in self.archaic_words
        )
        features["archaic_word_ratio"] = features["archaic_word_count"] / max(
            num_words, 1
        )

        features["num_long_words"] = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 7)
        features["long_word_ratio"] = features["num_long_words"] / max(num_words, 1)

        features["num_numbers"] = sum(1 for w in words if w.replace(".", "").isdigit())

        stopwords = set(
            [
                "the",
                "a",
                "an",
                "and",
                "or",
                "but",
                "in",
                "on",
                "at",
                "to",
                "for",
                "of",
                "with",
                "by",
                "from",
                "is",
                "are",
                "was",
                "were",
                "be",
                "been",
                "being",
                "have",
                "has",
                "had",
                "do",
                "does",
                "did",
                "will",
                "would",
                "can",
                "could",
                "shall",
                "should",
                "may",
                "might",
                "this",
                "that",
                "these",
                "those",
                "i",
                "you",
                "he",
                "she",
                "it",
                "we",
                "they",
            ]
        )
        features["stopword_ratio"] = sum(
            1 for w in words_lower if w in stopwords
        ) / max(num_words, 1)

        if self.word_length_stats["std"] > 0:
            word_lengths_list = [len(w) for w in words if w.isalpha()]
            if word_lengths_list:
                avg_wl = np.mean(word_lengths_list)
                features["word_len_zscore"] = (
                    avg_wl - self.word_length_stats["mean"]
                ) / self.word_length_stats["std"]
            else:
                features["word_len_zscore"] = 0
        else:
            features["word_len_zscore"] = 0

        return features

    def transform(self, X, y=None):
        if not self._is_fitted:
            raise ValueError("Must fit before transform")

        feature_list = []
        for text in X:
            features = self._extract_single_text(text)
            feature_list.append(features)

        df_features = pd.DataFrame(feature_list)

        char_ngram_features = self.char_ngram_vocab.transform(X).toarray()
        char_ngram_cols = [
            f"char_ngram_{i}" for i in range(char_ngram_features.shape[1])
        ]
        df_char = pd.DataFrame(char_ngram_features, columns=char_ngram_cols)

        word_ngram_features = self.word_ngram_vocab.transform(X).toarray()
        word_ngram_cols = [
            f"word_ngram_{i}" for i in range(word_ngram_features.shape[1])
        ]
        df_word = pd.DataFrame(word_ngram_features, columns=word_ngram_cols)

        tfidf_features = self.tfidf_char.transform(X).toarray()
        tfidf_cols = [f"tfidf_char_{i}" for i in range(tfidf_features.shape[1])]
        df_tfidf = pd.DataFrame(tfidf_features, columns=tfidf_cols)

        df_combined = pd.concat([df_features, df_char, df_word, df_tfidf], axis=1)

        if not hasattr(self, "scaler_fitted"):
            self.scaler.fit(df_combined)
            self.scaler_fitted = True

        scaled_features = self.scaler.transform(df_combined)

        return scaled_features

# ============================================================
# 6. MODEL DEFINITION (DeBERTaFeatureFusionModel)
# ============================================================
class DeBERTaFeatureFusionModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name: str = "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
        num_labels: int = 3,
        dropout: float = 0.3,
        hidden_dim: int = 1024,
        num_statistical_features: int = 48,
        label_smoothing: float = 0.1,
    ):
        super().__init__()

        self.config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.config.hidden_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.deberta = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name, config=self.config)
        self.hidden_size = self.config.hidden_size

        self.stat_projection = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(num_statistical_features, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )

        self.attention_pool = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size, num_heads=8, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

        self.gate_network = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size + 128, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(256, 2),
            nn.Softmax(dim=-1),
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size + 128, 512),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, num_labels),
        )

        self.loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=label_smoothing)
        self.num_labels = num_labels
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        attention_mask: torch.Tensor,
        statistical_features: torch.Tensor = None,
        labels: torch.Tensor = None,
    ):
        outputs = self.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_attentions=False,
            output_hidden_states=False,
            return_dict=True,
        )

        sequence_output = outputs.last_hidden_state
        cls_output = sequence_output[:, 0, :]

        key_padding_mask = ~attention_mask.bool()

        pooled_output, _ = self.attention_pool(
            query=cls_output.unsqueeze(1),
            key=sequence_output,
            value=sequence_output,
            key_padding_mask=key_padding_mask,
        )
        pooled_output = pooled_output.squeeze(1)

        combined_context = self.dropout(cls_output + pooled_output)

        if statistical_features is not None:
            stat_emb = self.stat_projection(statistical_features)
        else:
            stat_emb = torch.zeros(
                combined_context.size(0), 128, device=combined_context.device
            )

        gate_input = torch.cat([combined_context, stat_emb], dim=-1)
        gates = self.gate_network(gate_input)

        fused_features = (gates[:, 0:1] * combined_context) + (gates[:, 1:2] * stat_emb)

        logits = self.classifier(fused_features)

        output = {"logits": logits}

        if labels is not None:
            loss = self.loss_fn(logits, labels)
            output["loss"] = loss

        output["probs"] = F.softmax(logits, dim=-1)

        return output

# 7. INITIALIZE TOKENIZER, MODEL, OPTIMIZER, SCHEDULER
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

model.to(device)

backbone_params = []
head_params = []
for name, param in model.named_parameters():
    if param.requires_grad:
        if "deberta" in name:
            backbone_params.append(param)
        else:
            head_params.append(param)

learning_rate = 2e-5
weight_decay = 0.01
optimizer = AdamW(
    [
        {"params": backbone_params, "lr": learning_rate, "weight_decay": weight_decay},
        {
            "params": head_params,
            "lr": learning_rate * 2,
            "weight_decay": weight_decay * 0.5,
        },
    ]
)

warmup_steps = 200
total_steps = 5000


def lr_lambda(current_step):
    if current_step < warmup_steps:
        return float(current_step) / float(max(1, warmup_steps))
    progress = float(current_step - warmup_steps) / float(
        max(1, total_steps - warmup_steps)
    )
    return 0.5 * (1.0 + np.cos(np.pi * progress))


scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(optimizer, lr_lambda)

print(f"Model initialized: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,} parameters")
print(f"  Backbone: {sum(p.numel() for p in backbone_params):,} parameters")
print(f"  Custom heads: {sum(p.numel() for p in head_params):,} parameters")

# 8. PREPARE DATASETS AND DATALOADERS
# ============================================================
class SpookyTextDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, stat_features, labels=None):
        self.texts = texts
        self.stat_features = stat_features.astype(np.float32)
        self.labels = labels
        self.is_train = labels is not None

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        stat_feat = torch.FloatTensor(self.stat_features[idx])

        encoding = tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=max_length,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )

        item = {
            "input_ids": encoding["input_ids"].squeeze(0),
            "attention_mask": encoding["attention_mask"].squeeze(0),
            "statistical_features": stat_feat,
        }

        if self.is_train:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)

        return item


train_dataset = SpookyTextDataset(X_train, X_train_features, y_train_encoded)
val_dataset = SpookyTextDataset(X_val, X_val_features, y_val_encoded)
test_dataset = SpookyTextDataset(test_df["text"].values, X_test_features, labels=None)

batch_size = 8
train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset,
    batch_size=batch_size * 2,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset,
    batch_size=batch_size * 2,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
)

print(
    f"Train batches: {len(train_loader)}, Val batches: {len(val_loader)}, Test batches: {len(test_loader)}"
)

# ============================================================
# 9. TRAINING LOOP WITH MIXED PRECISION
# ============================================================
scaler = GradScaler()
num_epochs = 10
patience = 3
best_val_loss = float("inf")
best_model_state = None
patience_counter = 0

print("\nStarting training...")
for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0.0
    num_train_batches = 0

    for batch in train_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        stat_features = batch["statistical_features"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()

        with autocast():
            outputs = model(
                input_ids=input_ids,
                attention_mask=attention_mask,
                statistical_features=stat_features,
                labels=labels,
            )
            loss = outputs["loss"]

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        scheduler.step()

        total_train_loss += loss.item()
        num_train_batches += 1

    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / max(num_train_batches, 1)

    model.eval()
    val_preds = []
    val_labels_list = []
    total_val_loss = 0.0
    num_val_batches = 0

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            stat_features = batch["statistical_features"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=input_ids,
                    attention_mask=attention_mask,
                    statistical_features=stat_features,
                    labels=labels,
                )

            val_preds.append(outputs["probs"].cpu().numpy())
            val_labels_list.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
            total_val_loss += outputs["loss"].item()
            num_val_batches += 1

    avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / max(num_val_batches, 1)
    val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds, axis=0)
    val_labels = np.concatenate(val_labels_list, axis=0)

    epsilon = 1e-15
    val_preds_clipped = np.clip(val_preds, epsilon, 1.0 - epsilon)
    val_preds_norm = val_preds_clipped / val_preds_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    val_log_loss = 0.0
    n_samples = len(val_labels)
    for i in range(n_samples):
        true_class = val_labels[i]
        val_log_loss -= np.log(val_preds_norm[i, true_class])
    val_log_loss /= n_samples

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {avg_val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_log_loss:.4f}"
    )

    if val_log_loss < best_val_loss:
        best_val_loss = val_log_loss
        best_model_state = {k: v.cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
        patience_counter = 0
        print(f"  ✓ New best model with Val LogLoss: {val_log_loss:.4f}")
    else:
        patience_counter += 1
        if patience_counter >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered after {epoch+1} epochs")
            break

    gc.collect()
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

# ============================================================
# 10. LOAD BEST MODEL FOR INFERENCE
# ============================================================
print("\nLoading best model for inference...")
model.load_state_dict(best_model_state)
model.to(device)
model.eval()

# ============================================================
# 11. FINAL VALIDATION PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================
print("Computing final validation predictions...")
all_val_probs = []
all_val_labels = []

with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in val_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        stat_features = batch["statistical_features"].to(device)

        with autocast():
            outputs = model(
                input_ids=input_ids,
                attention_mask=attention_mask,
                statistical_features=stat_features,
            )

        all_val_probs.append(outputs["probs"].cpu().numpy())
        all_val_labels.append(batch["labels"].cpu().numpy())

all_val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
all_val_labels = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)

epsilon = 1e-15
val_probs_clipped = np.clip(all_val_probs, epsilon, 1.0 - epsilon)

final_val_log_loss = 0.0
n_val = len(all_val_labels)
for i in range(n_val):
    true_class = all_val_labels[i]
    final_val_log_loss -= np.log(val_probs_clipped[i, true_class])
final_val_log_loss /= n_val

# ============================================================
# 12. TEST INFERENCE
# ============================================================
print("Generating test predictions...")
all_test_probs = []

with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        stat_features = batch["statistical_features"].to(device)

        with autocast():
            outputs = model(
                input_ids=input_ids,
                attention_mask=attention_mask,
                statistical_features=stat_features,
            )

        all_test_probs.append(outputs["probs"].cpu().numpy())

all_test_probs = np.concatenate(all_test_probs, axis=0)

test_probs_clipped = np.clip(all_test_probs, epsilon, 1.0 - epsilon)
test_probs_norm = test_probs_clipped / test_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

# ============================================================
# 13. CREATE SUBMISSION FILE
# ============================================================
author_names = label_encoder.classes_

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"].values,
        author_names[0]: test_probs_norm[:, 0],
        author_names[1]: test_probs_norm[:, 1],
        author_names[2]: test_probs_norm[:, 2],
    }
)

submission_df = submission_df[["id", "EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]]

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"✓ Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"  Shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"  Columns: {list(submission_df.columns)}")

# ============================================================
# 14. FINAL VALIDATION SCORE OUTPUT
# ============================================================
print(f"Final Validation Score: {final_val_log_loss}")

## Evaluation

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

def clean_text(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    text = text.strip()
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[^\x00-\x7F\w\s\.\,\!\?\;\:\'\"\-\(\)\[\]\{\}]", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text

def extract_basic_features(texts):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=range(len(texts)))
    features["char_count"] = [len(t) for t in texts]
    features["word_count"] = [len(t.split()) for t in texts]
    features["avg_word_length"] = features["char_count"] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["sentence_count"] = [len(re.split(r"[.!?]+", t)) - 1 for t in texts]
    features["avg_sentence_length"] = features["word_count"] / (
        features["sentence_count"] + 1
    )
    for punct in [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", '"', "'", "-", "...", "--"]:
        features[f"punct_{punct}"] = [t.count(punct) for t in texts]
    features["punct_ratio"] = features[
        [f"punct_{p}" for p in [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", '"', "'", "-"]]
    ].sum(axis=1) / (features["char_count"] + 1)
    features["capital_ratio"] = [
        sum(1 for c in t if c.isupper()) / (len(t) + 1) for t in texts
    ]
    features["all_caps_words"] = [len(re.findall(r"\b[A-Z]{2,}\b", t)) for t in texts]
    features["quote_count"] = [t.count('"') + t.count('"') for t in texts]
    features["paren_count"] = [
        t.count("(") + t.count(")") + t.count("[") + t.count("]") for t in texts
    ]
    features["exclamation_ratio"] = features["punct_!"] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["question_ratio"] = features["punct_?"] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    sentences = [re.split(r"[.!?]+", t) for t in texts]
    features["starts_with_and"] = [
        sum(1 for s in sent_list if s.strip().lower().startswith("and"))
        for sent_list in sentences
    ]
    features["starts_with_but"] = [
        sum(1 for s in sent_list if s.strip().lower().startswith("but"))
        for sent_list in sentences
    ]
    features["starts_with_the"] = [
        sum(1 for s in sent_list if s.strip().lower().startswith("the"))
        for sent_list in sentences
    ]
    return features

def extract_readability_features(texts):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=range(len(texts)))

    def count_syllables(word):
        word = word.lower()
        vowels = "aeiouy"
        count = 0
        prev_vowel = False
        for char in word:
            if char in vowels:
                if not prev_vowel:
                    count += 1
                prev_vowel = True
            else:
                prev_vowel = False
        if count == 0:
            count = 1
        return count

    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        words = re.findall(r"\b\w+\b", text)
        if len(words) == 0:
            features.loc[i, "syllable_count"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "flesch_reading_ease"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "avg_syllables_per_word"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "long_word_ratio"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "very_long_word_ratio"] = 0
            continue
        syllables = sum(count_syllables(w) for w in words)
        sentences = max(len(re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)) - 1, 1)
        features.loc[i, "syllable_count"] = syllables
        features.loc[i, "avg_syllables_per_word"] = syllables / len(words)
        features.loc[i, "long_word_ratio"] = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 8) / len(
            words
        )
        features.loc[i, "very_long_word_ratio"] = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 12
        ) / len(words)
        if sentences > 0 and len(words) > 0:
            fre = (
                206.835
                - 1.015 * (len(words) / sentences)
                - 84.6 * (syllables / len(words))
            )
            features.loc[i, "flesch_reading_ease"] = max(0, min(100, fre))
        else:
            features.loc[i, "flesch_reading_ease"] = 0
    return features

    features_list.append(readability_feats)
    print("Extracting author-specific features...")
    author_feats = extract_author_specific_features(texts)
    features_list.append(author_feats)
    print("Extracting function word features...")
    func_word_feats = extract_function_word_features(texts)
    features_list.append(func_word_feats)
    print("Extracting TF-IDF features...")
    if fit_tfidf:
        tfidf_matrix, tfidf_vectorizer = extract_tfidf_features(texts, fit=True)
        tfidf_feats = pd.DataFrame(
            tfidf_matrix.toarray(),
            columns=[f"tfidf_{i}" for i in range(tfidf_matrix.shape[1])],
        )
        features_list.append(tfidf_feats)
        tfidf_vectorizer_out = tfidf_vectorizer
    else:
        tfidf_matrix, _ = extract_tfidf_features(
            texts, fit=False, vectorizer=tfidf_vectorizer
        )
        tfidf_feats = pd.DataFrame(
            tfidf_matrix.toarray(),
            columns=[f"tfidf_{i}" for i in range(tfidf_matrix.shape[1])],
        )
        features_list.append(tfidf_feats)
        tfidf_vectorizer_out = None
    all_features = pd.concat(features_list, axis=1)
    all_features = all_features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    all_features = all_features.fillna(0)
    return all_features, tfidf_vectorizer_out

class AuthorshipFusionModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, feature_dim, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, dropout_rate=DROPOUT_RATE):

            TRANSFORMER_MODEL,

        )
        self.feature_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(feature_dim, 512),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
        )
        self.fusion = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.transformer.config.hidden_size + 64, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(128, num_classes),
        )
        for module in self.feature_branch:
            if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.kaiming_normal_(
                    module.weight, mode="fan_in", nonlinearity="relu"
                )
                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
        for module in self.fusion:
            if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.xavier_normal_(module.weight)
                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, features):

        combined = torch.cat([cls_hidden, feature_embed], dim=1)
        logits = self.fusion(combined)
        logits = logits + 0.3 * transformer_logits
        return logits

class LabelSmoothCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=LABEL_SMOOTHING):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = torch.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (NUM_CLASSES - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        loss = torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))
        return loss

class AuthorshipDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, features, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.features = (
            torch.FloatTensor(features.values)
            if hasattr(features, "values")
            else torch.FloatTensor(features)
        )
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.encodings = []
        for text in texts:
            encoding = self.tokenizer(
                text,
                truncation=True,
                padding=False,
                max_length=self.max_length,
                return_tensors=None,
            )
            self.encodings.append(
                {
                    "input_ids": encoding["input_ids"],
                    "attention_mask": encoding["attention_mask"],
                }
            )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(
                self.encodings[idx]["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                self.encodings[idx]["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
            "features": self.features[idx],
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


def collate_fn(batch):
    input_ids = [item["input_ids"] for item in batch]
    attention_mask = [item["attention_mask"] for item in batch]
    features = torch.stack([item["features"] for item in batch])
    input_ids = torch.nn.utils.rnn.pad_sequence(
        input_ids, batch_first=True, padding_value=0
    )
    attention_mask = torch.nn.utils.rnn.pad_sequence(
        attention_mask, batch_first=True, padding_value=0
    )
    result = {
        "input_ids": input_ids,
        "attention_mask": attention_mask,

def extract_readability_features(texts):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=range(len(texts)))

    def count_syllables(word):
        word = word.lower()
        vowels = "aeiouy"
        count = 0
        prev_vowel = False
        for char in word:
            if char in vowels:
                if not prev_vowel:
                    count += 1
                prev_vowel = True
            else:
                prev_vowel = False
        if count == 0:
            count = 1
        return count

    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        words = re.findall(r"\b\w+\b", text)
        if len(words) == 0:
            features.loc[i, "syllable_count"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "flesch_reading_ease"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "avg_syllables_per_word"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "long_word_ratio"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "very_long_word_ratio"] = 0
            continue
        syllables = sum(count_syllables(w) for w in words)
        sentences = max(len(re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)) - 1, 1)
        features.loc[i, "syllable_count"] = syllables
        features.loc[i, "avg_syllables_per_word"] = syllables / len(words)
        features.loc[i, "long_word_ratio"] = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 8) / len(
            words
        )
        features.loc[i, "very_long_word_ratio"] = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 12
        ) / len(words)
        if sentences > 0 and len(words) > 0:
            fre = (
                206.835
                - 1.015 * (len(words) / sentences)
                - 84.6 * (syllables / len(words))
            )
            features.loc[i, "flesch_reading_ease"] = max(0, min(100, fre))
        else:
            features.loc[i, "flesch_reading_ease"] = 0
    return features

class AuthorshipFusionModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, feature_dim, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, dropout_rate=DROPOUT_RATE):
        super().__init__()
        self.transformer = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            TRANSFORMER_MODEL,
            num_labels=num_classes,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        self.feature_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(feature_dim, 512),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
        )
        self.fusion = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.transformer.config.hidden_size + 64, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(128, num_classes),
        )
        for module in self.feature_branch:
            if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.kaiming_normal_(
                    module.weight, mode="fan_in", nonlinearity="relu"
                )
                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
        for module in self.fusion:
            if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.xavier_normal_(module.weight)
                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, features):
        outputs = self.transformer.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        cls_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        transformer_logits = self.transformer.classifier(cls_hidden)
=======
        outputs = self.transformer.base_model(

        cls_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        transformer_logits = self.transformer.classifier(cls_hidden)
        feature_embed = self.feature_branch(features)
        combined = torch.cat([cls_hidden, feature_embed], dim=1)
        logits = self.fusion(combined)
        logits = logits + 0.3 * transformer_logits
        return logits


class LabelSmoothCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=LABEL_SMOOTHING):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = torch.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (NUM_CLASSES - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        loss = torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))
        return loss

class AuthorshipDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, features, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.features = (
            torch.FloatTensor(features.values)
            if hasattr(features, "values")
            else torch.FloatTensor(features)
        )
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.encodings = []
        for text in texts:
            encoding = self.tokenizer(
                text,
                truncation=True,
                padding=False,
                max_length=self.max_length,
                return_tensors=None,
            )
            self.encodings.append(
                {
                    "input_ids": encoding["input_ids"],
                    "attention_mask": encoding["attention_mask"],
                }
            )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(
                self.encodings[idx]["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                self.encodings[idx]["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
            "features": self.features[idx],
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


def collate_fn(batch):
    input_ids = [item["input_ids"] for item in batch]
    attention_mask = [item["attention_mask"] for item in batch]
    features = torch.stack([item["features"] for item in batch])
    input_ids = torch.nn.utils.rnn.pad_sequence(
        input_ids, batch_first=True, padding_value=0
    )
    attention_mask = torch.nn.utils.rnn.pad_sequence(
        attention_mask, batch_first=True, padding_value=0
    )
    result = {
        "input_ids": input_ids,
        "attention_mask": attention_mask,
        "features": features,
    }
    if "labels" in batch[0]:
        result["labels"] = torch.stack([item["labels"] for item in batch])
    return result

def get_warmup_scheduler(optimizer, warmup_steps, total_steps):
    def lr_lambda(current_step):
        if current_step < warmup_steps:
            return float(current_step) / float(max(1, warmup_steps))
        return max(
            0.0,
            float(total_steps - current_step)
            / float(max(1, total_steps - warmup_steps)),
        )

    return torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(optimizer, lr_lambda)

# 6. MODEL DEFINITION (DeBERTaFeatureFusionModel)
# ============================================================
class DeBERTaFeatureFusionModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name: str = "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
        num_labels: int = 3,
        dropout: float = 0.3,
        hidden_dim: int = 1024,
        num_statistical_features: int = 48,
        label_smoothing: float = 0.1,
    ):
        super().__init__()

        self.config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.config.hidden_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.deberta = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name, config=self.config)
        self.hidden_size = self.config.hidden_size

        self.stat_projection = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(num_statistical_features, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )

        self.attention_pool = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size, num_heads=8, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

        self.gate_network = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size + 128, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(256, 2),
            nn.Softmax(dim=-1),
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size + 128, 512),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, num_labels),
        )

        self.loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=label_smoothing)
        self.num_labels = num_labels
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        attention_mask: torch.Tensor,
        statistical_features: torch.Tensor = None,
        labels: torch.Tensor = None,
    ):
        outputs = self.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_attentions=False,
            output_hidden_states=False,
            return_dict=True,
        )

        sequence_output = outputs.last_hidden_state
        cls_output = sequence_output[:, 0, :]

        key_padding_mask = ~attention_mask.bool()

        pooled_output, _ = self.attention_pool(
            query=cls_output.unsqueeze(1),
            key=sequence_output,
            value=sequence_output,
            key_padding_mask=key_padding_mask,
        )
        pooled_output = pooled_output.squeeze(1)

        combined_context = self.dropout(cls_output + pooled_output)

        if statistical_features is not None:
            stat_emb = self.stat_projection(statistical_features)
        else:
            stat_emb = torch.zeros(
                combined_context.size(0), 128, device=combined_context.device
            )

        gate_input = torch.cat([combined_context, stat_emb], dim=-1)
        gates = self.gate_network(gate_input)

        # Project stat_emb to match combined_context dimension
        stat_proj = self.stat_projection_to_hidden(stat_emb)
        fused_features = (gates[:, 0:1] * combined_context) + (gates[:, 1:2] * stat_proj)

        logits = self.classifier(fused_features)

        output = {"logits": logits}

        if labels is not None:
            loss = self.loss_fn(logits, labels)
            output["loss"] = loss

        output["probs"] = F.softmax(logits, dim=-1)

        return output

    def _extract_single_text(self, text):
        features = {}
        words = text.split()
        num_words = len(words)
        chars = len(text)

        features["num_words"] = num_words
        features["num_chars"] = chars
        features["avg_word_len"] = chars / max(num_words, 1)
        features["chars_per_word"] = (
            np.mean([len(w) for w in words if w.isalpha()]) if words else 0
        )

        features["num_periods"] = text.count(".")
        features["num_commas"] = text.count(",")
        features["num_semicolons"] = text.count(";")
        features["num_colons"] = text.count(":")
        features["num_exclamations"] = text.count("!")
        features["num_questions"] = text.count("?")
        features["num_quotes"] = text.count('"') + text.count("'")
        features["num_dashes"] = text.count("-") + text.count("—")
        features["num_ellipsis"] = text.count("...")
        features["num_parens"] = text.count("(") + text.count(")")

        features["punct_per_word"] = (
            features["num_periods"]
            + features["num_commas"]
            + features["num_semicolons"]
            + features["num_exclamations"]
            + features["num_questions"]
        ) / max(num_words, 1)

        features["num_capitals"] = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper())
        features["capital_ratio"] = features["num_capitals"] / max(chars, 1)

        cap_words = [w for w in words if w and w[0].isupper()]
        features["num_capitalized_words"] = len(cap_words)
        features["capital_words_ratio"] = len(cap_words) / max(num_words, 1)

        unique_words = set(w.lower() for w in words if w.isalpha())
        features["unique_word_ratio"] = len(unique_words) / max(num_words, 1)

        words_lower = [w.lower().strip(".,!?;:\"'()[]{}") for w in words]
        word_counts = Counter(words_lower)

        for fw in self.function_words:
            features[f"fw_{fw}"] = word_counts.get(fw, 0) / max(num_words, 1)

        features["archaic_word_count"] = sum(
            1 for w in words_lower if w in self.archaic_words
        )
        features["archaic_word_ratio"] = features["archaic_word_count"] / max(
            num_words, 1
        )

        features["num_long_words"] = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 7)
        features["long_word_ratio"] = features["num_long_words"] / max(num_words, 1)

        features["num_numbers"] = sum(1 for w in words if w.replace(".", "").isdigit())

        stopwords = set(

            ]
        )
        features["stopword_ratio"] = sum(
            1 for w in words_lower if w in stopwords
        ) / max(num_words, 1)

        if self.word_length_stats["std"] > 0:
            word_lengths_list = [len(w) for w in words if w.isalpha()]
            if word_lengths_list:
                avg_wl = np.mean(word_lengths_list)
                features["word_len_zscore"] = (
                    avg_wl - self.word_length_stats["mean"]
                ) / self.word_length_stats["std"]
            else:
                features["word_len_zscore"] = 0
        else:
            features["word_len_zscore"] = 0

        return features

    def transform(self, X, y=None):
        if not self._is_fitted:
            raise ValueError("Must fit before transform")

        feature_list = []
        for text in X:
            features = self._extract_single_text(text)
            feature_list.append(features)

        df_features = pd.DataFrame(feature_list)

        char_ngram_features = self.char_ngram_vocab.transform(X).toarray()
        char_ngram_cols = [
            f"char_ngram_{i}" for i in range(char_ngram_features.shape[1])
        ]
        df_char = pd.DataFrame(char_ngram_features, columns=char_ngram_cols)

        word_ngram_features = self.word_ngram_vocab.transform(X).toarray()
        word_ngram_cols = [
            f"word_ngram_{i}" for i in range(word_ngram_features.shape[1])
        ]
        df_word = pd.DataFrame(word_ngram_features, columns=word_ngram_cols)

        tfidf_features = self.tfidf_char.transform(X).toarray()
        tfidf_cols = [f"tfidf_char_{i}" for i in range(tfidf_features.shape[1])]
        df_tfidf = pd.DataFrame(tfidf_features, columns=tfidf_cols)

        df_combined = pd.concat([df_features, df_char, df_word, df_tfidf], axis=1)

        if not hasattr(self, "scaler_fitted"):
            self.scaler.fit(df_combined)
            self.scaler_fitted = True

        scaled_features = self.scaler.transform(df_combined)

        return scaled_features

# 6. MODEL DEFINITION (DeBERTaFeatureFusionModel)
# ============================================================
class DeBERTaFeatureFusionModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name: str = "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
        num_labels: int = 3,
        dropout: float = 0.3,
        hidden_dim: int = 1024,
        num_statistical_features: int = 48,
        label_smoothing: float = 0.1,
    ):
        super().__init__()

        self.config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.config.hidden_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.deberta = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name, config=self.config)
        self.hidden_size = self.config.hidden_size

        self.stat_projection = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(num_statistical_features, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )

        self.attention_pool = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size, num_heads=8, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

        self.gate_network = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size + 128, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(256, 2),
            nn.Softmax(dim=-1),
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size + 128, 512),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, num_labels),
        )

        self.loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=label_smoothing)
        self.num_labels = num_labels
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        attention_mask: torch.Tensor,
        statistical_features: torch.Tensor = None,
        labels: torch.Tensor = None,
    ):
        outputs = self.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_attentions=False,
            output_hidden_states=False,
            return_dict=True,
        )

        sequence_output = outputs.last_hidden_state
        cls_output = sequence_output[:, 0, :]

        key_padding_mask = ~attention_mask.bool()

        pooled_output, _ = self.attention_pool(
            query=cls_output.unsqueeze(1),
            key=sequence_output,
            value=sequence_output,
            key_padding_mask=key_padding_mask,
        )
        pooled_output = pooled_output.squeeze(1)

        combined_context = self.dropout(cls_output + pooled_output)

        if statistical_features is not None:
            stat_emb = self.stat_projection(statistical_features)
        else:
            stat_emb = torch.zeros(
                combined_context.size(0), 128, device=combined_context.device
            )

        gate_input = torch.cat([combined_context, stat_emb], dim=-1)
        gates = self.gate_network(gate_input)

        fused_features = (gates[:, 0:1] * combined_context) + (gates[:, 1:2] * stat_emb)

        logits = self.classifier(fused_features)

        output = {"logits": logits}

        if labels is not None:
            loss = self.loss_fn(logits, labels)
            output["loss"] = loss

        output["probs"] = F.softmax(logits, dim=-1)

        return output

class SpookyTextDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, stat_features, labels=None):
        self.texts = texts
        self.stat_features = stat_features.astype(np.float32)
        self.labels = labels
        self.is_train = labels is not None

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        stat_feat = torch.FloatTensor(self.stat_features[idx])

        encoding = tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=max_length,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )

        item = {
            "input_ids": encoding["input_ids"].squeeze(0),
            "attention_mask": encoding["attention_mask"].squeeze(0),
            "statistical_features": stat_feat,
        }

        if self.is_train:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)

        return item

def extract_readability_features(texts):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=range(len(texts)))

    def count_syllables(word):
        word = word.lower()
        vowels = "aeiouy"
        count = 0
        prev_vowel = False
        for char in word:
            if char in vowels:
                if not prev_vowel:
                    count += 1
                prev_vowel = True
            else:
                prev_vowel = False
        if count == 0:
            count = 1
        return count

    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        words = re.findall(r"\b\w+\b", text)
        if len(words) == 0:
            features.loc[i, "syllable_count"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "flesch_reading_ease"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "avg_syllables_per_word"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "long_word_ratio"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "very_long_word_ratio"] = 0
            continue
        syllables = sum(count_syllables(w) for w in words)
        sentences = max(len(re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)) - 1, 1)
        features.loc[i, "syllable_count"] = syllables
        features.loc[i, "avg_syllables_per_word"] = syllables / len(words)
        features.loc[i, "long_word_ratio"] = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 8) / len(
            words
        )
        features.loc[i, "very_long_word_ratio"] = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 12
        ) / len(words)
        if sentences > 0 and len(words) > 0:

    return features

class LabelSmoothCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=LABEL_SMOOTHING):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = torch.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (NUM_CLASSES - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        loss = torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))
        return loss

    def lr_lambda(current_step):

def clean_text(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    text = text.strip()
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[^\x00-\x7F\w\s\.\,\!\?\;\:\'\"\-\(\)\[\]\{\}]", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text

def extract_basic_features(texts):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=range(len(texts)))
    features["char_count"] = [len(t) for t in texts]
    features["word_count"] = [len(t.split()) for t in texts]
    features["avg_word_length"] = features["char_count"] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["sentence_count"] = [len(re.split(r"[.!?]+", t)) - 1 for t in texts]
    features["avg_sentence_length"] = features["word_count"] / (
        features["sentence_count"] + 1
    )
    for punct in [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", '"', "'", "-", "...", "--"]:
        features[f"punct_{punct}"] = [t.count(punct) for t in texts]
    features["punct_ratio"] = features[
        [f"punct_{p}" for p in [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", '"', "'", "-"]]
    ].sum(axis=1) / (features["char_count"] + 1)
    features["capital_ratio"] = [
        sum(1 for c in t if c.isupper()) / (len(t) + 1) for t in texts
    ]
    features["all_caps_words"] = [len(re.findall(r"\b[A-Z]{2,}\b", t)) for t in texts]
    features["quote_count"] = [t.count('"') + t.count('"') for t in texts]
    features["paren_count"] = [
        t.count("(") + t.count(")") + t.count("[") + t.count("]") for t in texts
    ]
    features["exclamation_ratio"] = features["punct_!"] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["question_ratio"] = features["punct_?"] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    sentences = [re.split(r"[.!?]+", t) for t in texts]
    features["starts_with_and"] = [
        sum(1 for s in sent_list if s.strip().lower().startswith("and"))
        for sent_list in sentences
    ]
    features["starts_with_but"] = [
        sum(1 for s in sent_list if s.strip().lower().startswith("but"))
        for sent_list in sentences
    ]
    features["starts_with_the"] = [
        sum(1 for s in sent_list if s.strip().lower().startswith("the"))
        for sent_list in sentences
    ]
    return features

def extract_readability_features(texts):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=range(len(texts)))

    def count_syllables(word):
        word = word.lower()
        vowels = "aeiouy"
        count = 0
        prev_vowel = False
        for char in word:
            if char in vowels:
                if not prev_vowel:
                    count += 1
                prev_vowel = True
            else:
                prev_vowel = False
        if count == 0:
            count = 1
        return count

    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        words = re.findall(r"\b\w+\b", text)
        if len(words) == 0:
            features.loc[i, "syllable_count"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "flesch_reading_ease"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "avg_syllables_per_word"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "long_word_ratio"] = 0
            features.loc[i, "very_long_word_ratio"] = 0
            continue
        syllables = sum(count_syllables(w) for w in words)
        sentences = max(len(re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)) - 1, 1)
        features.loc[i, "syllable_count"] = syllables
        features.loc[i, "avg_syllables_per_word"] = syllables / len(words)
        features.loc[i, "long_word_ratio"] = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 8) / len(
            words
        )
        features.loc[i, "very_long_word_ratio"] = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 12
        ) / len(words)
        if sentences > 0 and len(words) > 0:
            fre = (
                206.835
                - 1.015 * (len(words) / sentences)
                - 84.6 * (syllables / len(words))
            )
            features.loc[i, "flesch_reading_ease"] = max(0, min(100, fre))
        else:
            features.loc[i, "flesch_reading_ease"] = 0
    return features

        return tfidf_matrix, None

    print("Extracting TF-IDF features...")
    if fit_tfidf:
        tfidf_matrix, tfidf_vectorizer = extract_tfidf_features(texts, fit=True)
        tfidf_feats = pd.DataFrame(
            tfidf_matrix.toarray(),
            columns=[f"tfidf_{i}" for i in range(tfidf_matrix.shape[1])],
        )
        features_list.append(tfidf_feats)
        tfidf_vectorizer_out = tfidf_vectorizer
    else:
        tfidf_matrix, _ = extract_tfidf_features(
            texts, fit=False, vectorizer=tfidf_vectorizer
        )
        tfidf_feats = pd.DataFrame(
            tfidf_matrix.toarray(),
            columns=[f"tfidf_{i}" for i in range(tfidf_matrix.shape[1])],
        )
        features_list.append(tfidf_feats)
        tfidf_vectorizer_out = None
    all_features = pd.concat(features_list, axis=1)
    all_features = all_features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    all_features = all_features.fillna(0)
    return all_features, tfidf_vectorizer_out

            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),

class LabelSmoothCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=LABEL_SMOOTHING):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = torch.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (NUM_CLASSES - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        loss = torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))
        return loss
